name: Olimpia OT
storyline:
In a world shaped by the gods of Greek mythology, mortals rise to challenge creatures, legends, and forces once believed to be beyond their reach.

Olimpia takes place in a vast realm where divine influence can be felt across ancient temples, dangerous hunting grounds, forgotten ruins, and territories ruled by mythical beings. Adventurers begin their journey as ordinary warriors, mages, assassins, archers, monks, druids, bards, or samurai, but their path can eventually lead far beyond mortal limits.

As they grow stronger, players uncover the power of the gods, face legendary creatures, forge increasingly powerful equipment, explore divine realms, and evolve their vocation through new paths of ascension.

The world of Olimpia is built around progression, exploration, crafting, challenging encounters, and competition. Every journey is shaped by the choices made along the way — from the deity a character follows to the equipment they create, the creatures they hunt, and the allies they fight beside.

In a land where gods still influence the fate of mortals, becoming powerful is only the beginning.

The true challenge is becoming a legend worthy of Olimpia.
summary: Olimpia OT is a Greek mythology-inspired MMORPG that combines classic Tibia-style gameplay with modern RPG systems and original content. Players explore a dangerous world inspired by the myths of Olympus, choose their vocation and divine allegiance, fight monsters and powerful bosses, discover dungeons, craft and upgrade equipment, and develop their characters through unique progression systems. Olimpia OT features eight distinct vocations, Divine Paths, a Devotion system, custom combat mechanics, ranked monsters, crafting, item upgrades, arenas, PvE and PvP content, and a persistent online world.
